fields.description: How tightly the desk is packed. Applies on its own — it is not tied to the colour switch below.
fields.label: Density

fields.options:
Comfortable — upstream Frappe spacing.
Compact — tighter form sections and rows, and the app launcher fills the width instead of sitting in a narrow column. Shipped default.
Dense — as tight as stays readable; best on large screens.

Changes apply live. Save to make them permanent for everyone.

fields.description: Off = the colours shipped with the app. On = the colours below.
fields.label: Use Custom Colours

fields.options: Colours apply live as you pick them, so you can see the result before saving. Save to make them permanent for everyone; use Reset to Defaults to go back to the shipped palette.

fields.description: Repaints the workspace pages with a navy canvas and floating white tiles. Off by default: it overrides a lot of ERPNext's own workspace layout, which varies between versions — leave it off to keep the standard display.
